title: Polio took the use of his leg. It didn't take his jump.
youtubeTitle: Polio took the use of his leg. It didn't take his jump.
caption:
Polio took the use of his leg. It didn't take his jump.

Sharad Kumar, from Motipur, Bihar, was left with permanent paralysis in one leg after a childhood bout of polio. He took up high jump in 2005 at St. Paul's School, Darjeeling, encouraged by his brother and went on to break his brother's own school records. After competing at the Rio 2016 Paralympics, he won bronze at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics in the men's high jump T63 event, clearing 1.83m despite competing injured and in heavy rain. He followed that with silver at the Paris 2024 Paralympics, setting a Paralympic record in his class at 1.88m - on top of Asian Para Games gold in 2014 and 2018 and a World Championships silver in 2017.
